meta.title: Abigail Caricato · Graphic design and art direction
meta.description: Brand identity, editorial, packaging and motion. Design that prints itself on memory, from the first sketch to the final file.
meta.ogAlt: Abigail Caricato, graphic design and art direction

hero.tagline: Design that prints itself on memory.
hero.intro: Brands, magazines, packaging and pieces in motion. Every project, from the first sketch to the print-ready file.

story.label: Story
story.title: Six sheets.
story.lead: A story told the way a printed piece is built: layer by layer, until everything is in register.

chapters.title: The kitchen table
chapters.body: Old magazines, scissors and glue. Before she knew what design was, Abigail was already making collages: one image on top of another until something new appeared.

chapters.title: Layers
chapters.body: Her first computer came with Photoshop, and with it an idea she never let go of: every image is a stack of decisions. Any step can be undone. The eye can't.

chapters.title: Vectors
chapters.body: Illustrator taught her patience: a Bézier curve is tuned one anchor at a time. That is where her first brands were born, and her obsession with type.

chapters.title: Grid
chapters.body: InDesign taught her the rhythm of a page: columns, margins and air. A well-set magazine reads without anyone noticing the grid.

chapters.title: Motion
chapters.body: After Effects and Premiere gave design a sense of time. A logo that arrives on the beat says more than one that just sits there.

chapters.title: Today
chapters.body: She designs whole systems: from a brand to its campaign, from the sketch to a PDF that reaches the printer without a single error. The full Adobe suite in the service of one clear idea.

work.label: Work
work.title: Selected work.
work.lead: Six concept projects: fictional brands and imagined briefs, solved end to end.

projects.name: Nácar
projects.brief: A jeweller working in silver and mother-of-pearl needed an identity as delicate as the pieces, and firm enough to live on a five-centimetre box.
projects.idea: The brand is born from the sheen of nacre: an N of hairlines and heavy strokes, as if engraved, on a disc that changes colour with the light.
projects.system: Monogram, wordmark in a high-contrast serif, a pearl-and-ink palette, and a pattern of fine waves, like the grain of nacre.

projects.name: Umbral
projects.brief: A quarterly architecture magazine wanted to return to print with layouts that breathe like the buildings it publishes.
projects.idea: Every issue is built on a twelve-column grid that stays visible: fine lines the cover shows without shame.
projects.system: Typographic covers, a modular grid, three levels of hierarchy and full-bleed photography.

projects.name: Ola Lenta
projects.brief: A festival of contemplative cinema needed a poster series that invited people to slow down.
projects.idea: Three posters, three speeds: the same wave stretches from one poster to the next until it is almost still.
projects.system: Poster series, social pieces and short animations, all built from the same wave.

projects.name: Almácigo
projects.brief: A seed brand for urban gardens wanted packets that could be understood at a glance on the shelf.
projects.idea: Each variety has its own illustration and colour; when to sow is read on a graphic calendar, with no small print.
projects.system: Packet system, vector illustrations per variety, a sowing calendar and the die line.

projects.name: Vértigo
projects.brief: A thriller series needed a thirty-second title sequence.
projects.idea: Lines spin towards the centre like a spiral staircase; the title appears when the vertigo stops.
projects.system: Storyboard, kinetic type, rhythm cut to the sound and versions for social.

projects.name: Lumbre
projects.brief: A candle brand wanted a warm campaign that didn't fall into the obvious.
projects.idea: The whole campaign is lit by the flame: one light source, deep backgrounds and retouching that keeps the texture of the wax.
projects.system: Art direction, retouching and colour, posters and social pieces.

tools.label: Tools
tools.title: The full suite.
tools.lead: She knows every Adobe tool inside out and picks the right one for each stage. Each one here with a shortcut worth having at your fingertips.

steps.name: Brief
steps.body: Listen first: what needs saying, to whom and with what resources.

steps.name: Research
steps.body: References, competitors and context. A moodboard with judgement, not a pile of images.

steps.name: Sketches
steps.body: Plenty of ideas on paper before opening the computer. Two or three are chosen to develop.

steps.name: System
steps.body: The idea becomes rules: colour, type, grid and how it applies to every piece.

steps.name: Final art
steps.body: Files checked for print or screen: CMYK, 300 dpi, bleed and fonts included.

manifesto.label: Manifesto
manifesto.text: Good design goes unnoticed. It is felt, remembered and chosen again.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Got a project?
contact.body: A new brand, a magazine, a package or a campaign. Tell her your idea and start with the first sketch.

footer.colophon: Set in Bodoni Moda, Hanken Grotesk and DM Mono.
footer.note: The projects are concepts: fictional brands and briefs.
